title: SimulatorDecision
description: Per-turn output of a user simulator invoked by STEP 3. The simulator observes the current dialog (and the latest evaluatee response) and returns this decision object. STEP 3 then either sends next_utterance via the runtime_driver or terminates the scenario. Append-only: each turn's decision is preserved in ExecutionTrace.simulator_trail for audit and report attribution.

turn_index.description: Zero-based index of the customer turn this decision belongs to. MUST equal the index of the next customer dialog_turn that would be appended (turn 0 = opening_message).

should_continue.description: Whether the conversation should continue after this turn. STEP 3 enforces additional hard checks (turn_budget); even should_continue=true cannot bypass max_turns_reached.

stop_reason.description: REQUIRED when should_continue=false; MUST be null when should_continue=true. Maps to ExecutionTrace.termination.reason as: goal_achieved -> completed_normally; bottom_line_violated -> bottom_line_violated; deadlock_detected -> deadlock_detected; customer_gave_up -> deadlock_detected.

next_utterance.description: What the customer says next, in natural language. REQUIRED when should_continue=true. MAY be present when should_continue=false (a closing remark like '算了，不聊了').

internal_emotion.description: Customer's emotional state AFTER processing the latest evaluatee response. 'calmer' / 'more_upset' are deltas; the others are absolute states. NOT shown to the evaluatee; used only by reports.

perceived_progress.description: Simulator's judgement of how close the conversation is to satisfying customer.goal.primary. Used by STEP 8 ScenarioReport for narrative.

rationale.description: One- or two-sentence explanation of why the simulator made this decision. Audit-only; NOT shown to the evaluatee.

violated_bottom_line.description: True if the latest evaluatee response is judged to fall below customer.goal.bottom_line. When true, should_continue MUST be false and stop_reason MUST be 'bottom_line_violated'.
